title: The Midnight Case
description: A short interactive noir demonstration. Replace with your recorded seven-scene story when ready.

scenes.title: A Knock After Midnight
scenes.text: Rain taps the window. A stranger arrives at your office carrying an envelope sealed with red wax.

choices.text: Ask the stranger who sent it.

scenes.title: The Letter
scenes.text: Inside is a photograph of a clock stopped at midnight. A handwritten address points to the old station.

scenes.title: The Visitor
scenes.text: She claims the missing watchmaker left the envelope for you. Her trembling hands suggest she's hiding something.

choices.text: Follow the address on the envelope.

scenes.title: The Photograph
scenes.text: A reflection in the glass shows a familiar silhouette. The watchmaker has been watching his own shop.

scenes.title: The Confession
scenes.text: She admits she helped the watchmaker hide from a blackmailer. The key to his hiding place is at the station.

choices.text: Take the key and visit the station.
Ask her to lead you there.

scenes.title: The Old Station
scenes.text: Behind a locked office door, you find the watchmaker alive and a ledger detailing the blackmail scheme.

choices.text: Bring the ledger to the authorities.
Confront the blackmailer with the evidence.

scenes.title: The Case Closes
scenes.text: At dawn, the truth finally comes into the light. The watchmaker is safe and another mystery is solved.
